::: {.item}
### [Practitioners' Circle](practitioners-circle.qmd)

This retreat is for practitioners who want to lead groups with more
confidence. Each participant leads a session in their own practice and gets
feedback from the group.

Tentatively May 2027 · three days · Germany · in English
:::

::: {.item}
### [Moving Together](moving-together.qmd)

This is a movement retreat for anyone. It brings together yoga, tantra and
improvised movement, alone, in pairs and as a whole group. No experience is
needed.

Tentatively September 2027 · three days · Germany · in English
:::

:::
